biography: Valtteri "Valt" Bottas, a name synonymous with flamboyant speed and audacious maneuvers, hails from the small Finnish town of Nastola. His journey began not on a traditional karting track, but on the frozen lakes of his homeland, where he honed his car control skills drifting souped-up snowmobiles under the watchful eye of his father, a former rally driver. He transitioned to karts at 14, quickly dominating the local scene before making a splash in European junior formulas. A defining moment came in the energyX Faenza junior program, where he pulled off an impossible overtake at Imola, cementing his reputation as a risk-taker. Now at 32, and driving for Starward G.P., Bottas is in his prime, balancing raw talent with a growing maturity, though his aggressive instincts remain ever-present. He aims for the championship this season.
drivingStyle: Bottas is known for his aggressive and visually stunning driving style. He's a late-braking specialist, often diving into corners with a degree of commitment that borders on reckless. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also occasionally results in lock-ups and missed apexes. He's less meticulous about tire management than some of his rivals, preferring to push for maximum performance in shorter bursts. Under pressure, Bottas tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes to his detriment, but often to the delight of the crowd.

rivalries.reason: A constant battle on track for position. Rossi is very consistent and clean, which clashes heavily with Bottas' aggressive style.

careerHighlight: Winning the Monaco Grand Prix in 2024 after a daring last-lap overtake, diving down the inside of two cars at the Nouvelle Chicane.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2022 season due to a mechanical failure, losing the championship by a single point.
